devices.label: SURFboard S33 DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem
devices.description: DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem bonding 32x8 SC-QAM plus 2x2 OFDM/OFDMA channels, presented as one 2.5GBASE-T port and one 1GBASE-T port from a single F-connector coax drop.
devices.notes: Vendor spec table: 'One 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet Port and One 1 Gigabit Ethernet Port', 2 DS x 2 US OFDM DOCSIS 3.1 channels, 32 x 8 DOCSIS 3.0 bonded channels, 'Built-in Wi-Fi: NO', 'Digital Voice: NO'. RF side carries the DOCSIS 3.1 class (10G), the Ethernet pair stays asymmetric so a 2.5G client can exceed 1 Gbps. Both LAN ports are bridged - one client-side MAC domain, no NAT, no routing.

devices.label: Touchstone CM8200 DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem
devices.description: DOCSIS 3.1 Touchstone modem with 2x192 MHz OFDM downstream and 2x96 MHz OFDMA upstream plus 32x8 SC-QAM fallback, bridged to two Gigabit Ethernet ports.
devices.notes: Arris spec sheet: '32x8/2x2 DOCSIS 3.1 Cable Modem', 2x192 MHz OFDM downstream and 2x96 MHz OFDMA upstream, 32x8 SC-QAM at 108-1002 MHz, 'supports 2 Gigabit Ethernet ports for enhanced data throughput', up to 2.5 Gbps of broadband data. Operator-spec model (Cox Gigablast roll-out): no Wi-Fi, no voice ports on this variant.

devices.label: NETGEAR Nighthawk CM2050V 2.5 Gbps DOCSIS 3.1 cable telephony modem
devices.description: DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem with 32x8 SC-QAM plus 2 OFDM and 2 OFDMA channels, exposing a single 2.5GBASE-T port; the two RJ11 telephone jacks are FXS voice lines, not data ports.
devices.notes: Datasheet technical specifications: '32x8 SC-QAM + 2 OFDM & 2 OFDMA', '1 x 2.5G Ethernet Port', 'Two Telephone Ports' that prioritize voice (FXS - deliberately excluded from interfaces, a phone jack is not a data port). One wired data port only, so no bridging decisions to make.

devices.label: NETGEAR Nighthawk AC1900 cable modem router (C7000)
devices.description: Two-in-one DOCSIS 3.0 24x8 cable modem and 4-port gigabit router with dual-band 802.11ac Wi-Fi, all behind one coax F-connector.
devices.notes: Datasheet (C7000v2): '24 downstream & 8 upstream channels' DOCSIS 3.0 bonding (960 Mbps DS class), 'Four (4) 10/100/1000 Mbps (4 LAN) Gigabit Ethernet ports', IEEE 802.11 b/g/n 2.4 GHz + 802.11 a/n/ac 5 GHz. The single USB 2.0 port is excluded per batch rule. Unlike the plain modems this one carries the full routed stack: NAT, SPI firewall, DHCP server, web UI.

devices.label: Motorola MB7621 24x8 DOCSIS 3.0 cable modem
devices.description: DOCSIS 3.0 cable modem with 24 bonded downstream and 8 bonded upstream channels and exactly one Gigabit Ethernet port; no Wi-Fi, no telephone jacks.
devices.notes: Datasheet: 24x8 DOCSIS 3.0, 1029/246 Mbps nominal DS/US, 'Gigabit Ethernet port for a high-speed plug-in connection to a router, computer, or other Internet-capable device'. Explicitly 'does not have a built-in wireless router and does not have telephone jacks', so the port list is one F-connector and one RJ45.

devices.label: Hitron CODA56 DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem
devices.description: DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem with 2x2 OFDM/OFDMA plus 32x8 SC-QAM bonding, presenting a single 2.5GBASE-T port off one F-connector.
devices.notes: Datasheet key features: 'DOCSIS 3.1 2x2 OFDM/OFDMA', 'DOCSIS 3.0 32x8 Channel Bonding', 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port; user manual rates service up to 6 Gbps. Single wired port, no Wi-Fi, no voice - a pure bridge.

devices.label: Technicolor TC4400 DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem
devices.description: DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem with 2x2 OFDM(A) bonded channels and 32x8 DOCSIS 3.0 bonding, driving two 10/100/1000BASE-T LAN ports.
devices.notes: Datasheet: '2 x 2 OFDM(A) bonded channels in DOCSIS 3.1 mode', '32 x 8 bonded channels in DOCSIS 3.0 mode', DOCSIS 3.1 downstream up to 3.6 Gbps (3.0 mode 1372 Mbps theoretical), 'Interfaces LAN: 2 10/100/1000 Base-T Ethernet ports', DS 54-1002 MHz / up to 204 MHz split. Discontinued but still widely deployed by MSOs, so the two-port bridge shape matters for topologies.

devices.label: Ubiquiti UniFi Cable Internet (UCI) DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem
devices.description: 1U rack-mountable DOCSIS 3.1/3.0 cable modem with dual OFDM plus 32 SC-QAM downstream and dual OFDMA plus 8 SC-QAM upstream, wired as a single 2.5GbE RJ45 port.
devices.notes: Ubiquiti tech specs: 'Networking interface: (1) 2.5 GbE RJ45 port'; 'RF interface: (1) Bluetooth v4.1, Upload: Dual OFDMA/(8) SC-QAM 5-42 MHz switchable 5-85 MHz, Download: Dual OFDM/(32) SC-QAM 108-1002 MHz'; 'DOCSIS interface: (1) DOCSIS 3.1/3.0'. Managed from UniFi Network (8.0.7+) through an upstream cloud gateway; acts as an unmanaged bridge once activated. The model code is UCI - this is the box sold as the Ubiquiti cable modem for UISP/UniFi ISP deployments.

devices.label: Hitron CODA6021 DOCSIS 4.0 cable gateway
devices.description: DOCSIS 4.0 gateway with 5 configurable OFDM and 7 OFDMA channels plus 32x8 DOCSIS 3.0 fallback, tri-band Wi-Fi 7, and two 10GBASE-T plus two 2.5GBASE-T LAN ports.
devices.notes: Datasheet: 'DOCSIS 4.0 5x7 OFDM/OFDMA', 'DOCSIS 3.0 32x8 Channel Bonding', switchable upstream 5-85 / 5-204 / 5-85 + 108-396 MHz, downstream up to 1794 MHz, and interfaces '1 x RF F-Type 75 ohm female', '2 x RJ-45 100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G BASE-T', '2 x RJ-45 100M/1G/2.5G BASE-T'. Wi-Fi 7 is 4x4 on 2.4/5/6 GHz; wireless speeds here are per-band 4x4 802.11be (40/160/320 MHz) approximations. Voice-capable gateway, so its RJ11 FXS jacks are omitted. This is the only DOCSIS 4.0 CPE I could verify from a vendor datasheet, and it ships as a gateway rather than a bare modem.

devices.label: DrayTek Vigor167 VDSL2 35b Supervectoring modem router
devices.description: VDSL2 35b Supervectoring / ADSL2+ bridge-router with one RJ11 DSL port and two Gigabit Ethernet LAN ports, no Wi-Fi.
devices.notes: Vendor page: 'Vigor167 is a VDSL2 35b modem/router. It's equipped with 1 RJ-11 port and 2 GbE LAN ports', download up to 300 Mbps, built-in DSL modem backward compatible with ADSL2+. Datasheet drawing shows 1 x VDSL2 35b WAN (RJ-11) + 2 x GbE RJ-45. Two operation modes - VDSL2/ADSL2+ bridging or router - so both l2-forward and the routed stack are modelled. VDSL2 35b is a 100M-class line in engine terms.

devices.label: AVM FRITZ!Box 7530 VDSL2 Supervectoring DSL router
devices.description: DSL router with an integrated VDSL2 35b Supervectoring / ADSL2+ modem on one DSL jack, four gigabit LAN ports (LAN 1 can act as WAN) and dual-band Wi-Fi 5.
devices.notes: AVM datasheet/manual: interfaces 'VDSL or ADSL connection', '4 x gigabit Ethernet; WAN via LAN 1 port', Wi-Fi AC up to 866 Mbit/s (5 GHz) + Wi-Fi N up to 400 Mbit/s (2.4 GHz), DECT base and analogue telephone ports. Per batch rule the FXS telephone ports and the USB 2.0 socket are excluded. Note the DSL socket is physically an RJ45 with TAE/RJ11 adapters in the box - modelled as the engine's dsl/rj11 line. Managed by web UI and TR-069, no CLI.

devices.label: Casa Systems C3200 CMTS (3RU, 1x SMM + 3x DQM16 + 3x DCU16)
devices.description: 3RU CMTS chassis with one Switch & Management Module carrying 12 gigabit Ethernet uplinks, fully populated with 3x DQM16 downstream modules (48 QAM channels on 12 F-connectors) and 3x DCU16 upstream modules (48 channels on 24 F-connectors).
devices.notes: Casa C3200 datasheet: 3RU chassis, 'one Switch and Management Module slot and six slots for DOCSIS interface modules'. SMM = '12-port GbE copper or fiber' uplinks plus '10/100BaseT management port' and 'RS232 serial port (DB9)'. DQM16 = 16 downstream QAM channels over 4 F-type 75 ohm ports (4 channels/port, ~152 Mbps per port); DCU16 = 16 upstream channels in 8 F-type ports (2 channels/port, ~61 Mbps per port). Fully populated 3 x DQM16 + 3 x DCU16 gives the datasheet's headline 48DS x 48US density: 12 downstream and 24 upstream service-group F-connectors, each rated 100M in engine terms rather than the chassis aggregate. Category is 'modem' per batch convention - the repo's other CMTS entries (E6000, cBR-8, C100G) use 'router'.
